name: Sissy Squat
instructions: Stand holding a support with feet hip-width apart.
Bend your knees forward while leaning your torso back.
Lower until you feel a strong quad stretch.
longevityNotes: Squatting is the foundation of getting up, sitting down, and climbing stairs. Keeping leg strength and knee range preserves independence decades longer than any single other movement.
overview: A bodyweight squat leaning back on the toes to heavily load the quads.
